name: preserve-project-intent
description: Prevents mission drift across long-running and parallel AI work while preserving completion boundaries, blocker contracts, and return points.

interface.shortDescription: Prevent mission drift across long, parallel AI work.
interface.longDescription: Separates mission, milestone, active task, blocker, and return point; controls nested scope expansion; and creates or consumes canonical cross-session handoffs without mistaking local completion for project completion.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Preserve Project Intent to keep this project's mission, current milestone, completion boundary, and return point authoritative while the work continues.
